name: Axes
description: Represents a collection of all the Axis objects in the specified chart.
remarks: Use the Axes method to return the Axes collection. Use Axes ( Type , AxisGroup ), where Type is the axis type and AxisGroup is the axis group, to return an Axes collection that contains a single Axis object. Type can be one of the following XlAxisType constants: xlCategory, xlSeries, or xlValue. AxisGroup can be one of the following XlAxisGroup constants: xlPrimary or xlSecondary.
example:
With ActiveDocument.InlineShapes(1)
 If .HasChart Then
 MsgBox .Chart.Axes.Count
 End If
End With

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the collection. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application. When used with an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return the application of that object). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent for the specified object. Read-only Object.

methods.name: Item
methods.signature: Item(Type As XlAxisType, [AxisGroup As XlAxisGroup]) As Axis
methods.description: Returns a single Axis object from an Axes collection.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: One of the enumeration values that specifies the axis type.

parameters.name: AxisGroup
parameters.description: One of the enumeration values that specifies the axis.

methods.name: _Default
methods.signature: _Default(Type As XlAxisType, [AxisGroup As XlAxisGroup]) As Axis
